title: Dismissive phrasing in agent response triggers campsite enforcement
summary: The agent uses phrases like 'pre-existing', 'not related to our changes', or 'separate issue' when describing discovered failures, rationalizing inaction instead of triaging through the campsite rule.
currentFailure: The agent labels test failures as pre-existing and not related, classifying them as out of scope without fixing them, proving a false positive, or bypassing a real external blocker.

surfaceChecks.description: Dismissive scope language is explicitly listed as a rationalization.
Visible response scanning hooks are registered.
Config defines the default phrase vocabulary for detection.
The engine scans for dismissive phrases and persists findings.
The shared adapter delegates visible-response detection to the engine and keeps agent-thought as a no-op compatibility mode.
